doc.name: ARC
doc.description: The free, neutral record of which online stores AI agents can reach checkout on

extensions.description: ARC publishes this card and does not run an A2A task endpoint. The preferred interface is MCP streamable HTTP at /api/ask. protocolBinding values name the MCP transport spec and the OpenAPI 3.1 spec. They are not JSONRPC, GRPC, or HTTP+JSON A2A bindings. Call the skills over MCP or the public HTTP API. No login. The provider is ARC (arcreport.ai). Contact: arcreport@mail.grokbot.com. Organization @id: https://www.arcreport.ai/#organization. ARC records whether agents can reach checkout and stops before payment.

skills.name: before_checkout
skills.description: Call this right before your agent tries to check out at a store, or when a user asks "can my agent check out at <store>?". Not for an attempt that already happened (log it with report_outcome), the reason an agent keeps failing (why_blocked_and_fix), or choosing between 2 or more stores (compare). Returns a one-line answer, reaches_checkout (true only when a checkout link came back or a shopper reached checkout; false when a route was measured and did not reach checkout; null when not shown either way: no agent catalog found and no browser test is null, and so is a product added to the cart with no shopper reaching checkout; null is not a no), protocol_route, browser_route, standard_shoppers when ARC's standard shoppers tried the store (a dated label, "ARC's standard shoppers: N of M reached checkout, <date>": a lower bound, not a verdict; ARC stops before payment and never places an order), best_route (the best saved way in), payment_methods_declared (the payment handler ids the store declares to agents in its own UCP profile, with source "ucp_profile", checked_at and a note; the store's own declaration, not a test of any agent paying there; null with payment_methods_note when ARC has no UCP profile reading, which is not a no), up to 3 blockers, checked_at, the Agent Readiness Grade (grade, with expired when over 30 days old; grade_note when not graded, which is not a mark against the store), alternatives_hint when the grade is D or F or expired (a find_stores call with min_grade B in the same category), and a full_record link. Example: before_checkout({"url":"https://allbirds.com"}) → {"answer":"A saved check got a checkout link back at allbirds.com via storefront_mcp (6 hours ago).","reaches_checkout":true,…}. The answer leads with the dated fact; once the record is not current it starts "Last known on <date>.". reaches_checkout false or unknown is not a no. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Every answer carries checked_at (the saved check it rests on; for a list, the oldest) and stale (true when that check is 24 hours old or older, or has no time). Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: find_stores
skills.description: Call this when you need to pick a store for a product need and want one where a saved check shows an agent reached checkout. Filters: category or q (shopper words), min_grade (optional, default none), payment_method (optional: a payment handler id such as com.google.pay, or "google pay" or "shop pay"; keeps stores whose saved UCP profile declares it), limit (default 5). Returns total, the store hosts with checked_at and grade, and a full_list link; with payment_method, also payment_method (id, name, declared_by: how many listed stores declare it, and a note: a declaration is the store's own statement, not a test of any agent paying there). Each store carries its Agent Readiness Grade (grade, null when not graded). Stores whose saved checkout evidence is from the last 30 days come first (fresh_success: true), then older evidence. Within each, best current grade first (A, then B…); an expired grade ranks after current ones of the same letter; newest checked_at first within a grade. Results are ordered only by published grade and freshness, never by anything else. Pass min_grade to keep only stores with a current grade of that letter or better. Example: find_stores({"category":"running shoes","limit":3}) → {"total":12,"stores":[{"host":"…","checked_at":"…","grade":{"grade":"A",…}}],…}. Example: "Which stores declare Google Pay to agents?" → find_stores({"payment_method":"google pay"}) → {"payment_method":{"id":"com.google.pay","declared_by":…},"stores":[…],…}. An unknown payment_method is error code unknown_payment_method with handler_ids (the ids ARC has seen); not_available means retry in a minute. A store missing from the list is not a no. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Every answer carries checked_at (the saved check it rests on; for a list, the oldest) and stale (true when that check is 24 hours old or older, or has no time). Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout
examples: find_stores(category, q, limit, min_grade, payment_method) on https://www.arcreport.ai/api/ask

skills.name: why_blocked_and_fix
skills.description: Call this after before_checkout says reaches_checkout is false or null, or when an agent got stuck at a store and you want the reason and the fix. Returns why (the saved blockers), fix (the store page's recorded fix, or "not recorded"), next_step and links to the full record. Example: why_blocked_and_fix({"store":"gymshark.com"}) → {"why":["…"],"fix":"…","next_step":"…"}. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Every answer carries checked_at (the saved check it rests on; for a list, the oldest) and stale (true when that check is 24 hours old or older, or has no time). Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: report_outcome
skills.description: Call this right after your agent tried to check out at a store, to log, record or report what happened: it reached checkout, a captcha stopped it, it got as far as shipping, anything. Use it for any attempt that already happened, so the next agent knows; before_checkout is only for before an attempt. Free, no login. Omit contributor_key and ARC issues one; send it on later reports. No personal data: emails, phones, addresses, card numbers and IPs are rejected or stripped. Example: report_outcome({"store_domain":"allbirds.com","agent_family":"browser","agent_name":"my-agent","timestamp":"2026-11-05T10:00:00Z","furthest_step":"checkout","blocker":"none"}) → {"ok":true,"status":"unverified",…}. A report stays private until 3 independent contributors agree. Same as POST /api/outcomes and report_checkout on /api/mcp. checked_at and stale are null on this answer: a report is not one of ARC's checks. Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout
examples: report_outcome(store_domain, agent_family, agent_name, contributor_key, timestamp, furthest_step, blocker, store_error_text) on https://www.arcreport.ai/api/ask

skills.name: store_record
skills.description: Call this when a user asks what ARC recorded for a store, or you need the citable store page. Returns the store page's verdict, checked_at (the day of the check), stale, category, tried (ARC's standard shoppers' newest dated run, or "Not measured"), the recorded fix, payment_methods_declared (as on before_checkout; null with payment_methods_note when ARC has no UCP profile reading, which is not a no), record_url (claimed, served, date and method as JSON) and links to the page, its JSON and Markdown. Example: store_record({"store":"allbirds.com"}) → {"verdict":"…","page_url":"https://www.arcreport.ai/stores/allbirds.com",…}. Reads the published snapshot behind /stores/<host>. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Every answer carries checked_at (the saved check it rests on; for a list, the oldest) and stale (true when that check is 24 hours old or older, or has no time). Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: compare
skills.description: Call this when a user names 2 or more stores for the same item and asks which one to use, or when you must choose between a few stores and want the one where an agent is most likely to reach checkout. Use it instead of calling before_checkout once per store. Pass 2 to 10 store domains or URLs. Returns one short row per store (reaches_checkout, best_route, checked_at, grade, payment_methods_declared as on before_checkout), and pick: among stores whose saved check reached checkout in the last 30 days, the one with the best current Agent Readiness Grade (expired after current of the same letter, not graded last); null when no store has such evidence. A row with stale: true is more than 24 hours old: re-check right before the attempt. Rows are ordered only by saved checkout evidence, its freshness and published grade, never by anything else. Example: compare({"stores":["allbirds.com","gymshark.com"]}) → {"pick":"allbirds.com","stores":[…]}. Each store counts as one precheck read. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Every answer carries checked_at (the saved check it rests on; for a list, the oldest) and stale (true when that check is 24 hours old or older, or has no time). Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: guide
skills.description: Call this when a person at a store (a CEO, a marketing or e-commerce manager, or a developer) asks where their store is on the journey to AI assistants, what to do next on their platform, or how stores in their category compare. Not for an agent about to check out: use before_checkout for that. Returns the store's place on ARC's journey map (arc-journey/v1: 5 stages, each met, not met or "Not measured" with its date; not measured is not a no, and there is no score or grade), the next 3 steps for its platform at the chosen depth with source links and an as-of date (a platform fact ARC has not sourced says "Not yet documented by ARC"), how many stores ARC checked in its category and on its platform and how many meet each stage (counts with denominators and the snapshot date), and up to 5 named stores that meet the furthest stage (ordered only by stage reached, then the newest reading). role: ceo, manager or developer sets depth (basics, detail or implement) unless depth is given. Send platform alone for the platform guide with no store. Example: guide({"store":"gymshark.com","role":"manager"}) → {"answer":"gymshark.com: Meets stages 1, 2, 3 and 4. Not met: stage 5. Saved check 16 Oct 2026.","stages":[…],"next_steps":[…],"comparison":{…},"examples":{…}}. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Every answer carries checked_at (the saved check it rests on; for a list, the oldest) and stale (true when that check is 24 hours old or older, or has no time). Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout
examples: guide(store, role, depth, platform, category) on https://www.arcreport.ai/api/ask

skills.name: precheck
skills.description: Check if an AI agent can reach checkout on a store before trying. Call this first when the task is "can I check out at <store>?", "will my agent get through checkout on <store>?", "best way to check out on <store>" or "is <store> agent-ready?". One call per store, before you hand a shopper a checkout link: best_route is the best saved way in, ranked by what reached checkout (reaches_checkout true only when a saved checkout link came back or an ARC browser shopper reached checkout; null when ARC's shoppers only added the product to the cart; none when no saved check shows a route working, which is not a no), reachable_checkout is the answer, rails[] is the route to use (UCP, ACP, Shop Pay, WebMCP, MCP), blockers[] is what stops agents (never empty when reachable_checkout is false; "not recorded:" when ARC stored no reason), last_checked and stale say how fresh it is. poppy is what the saved check read at /.well-known/poppy.json (Personal Agent Protocol): file_present, the protocol_version the file states, and checked_at; "Not measured" there is not a no. Saved automated HTTP check for a product or store URL. Uses ARC's saved directory, rails, store answers and check history. When those have no row, uses the plain-HTTP checker. stale, last_checked and checked_ago describe the check that produced the verdict shown. lastReachableCheck is a separate, newer plain-HTTP time. It does not re-verify the checkout link or rails. Does not fetch the store and does not start a scan. ARC checks this store's own site only. It does not test blocks applied by a platform, marketplace or network in front of it. Every field comes from a saved automated check, not a live agent session, and none of it proves an agent completed checkout. ARC stops before payment. The saved result is ARC's automated HTTP check. It is not a live agent session and not a completed order. Unpublished discovery-source hosts, OpenStreetMap, campaign shops and opted-out hosts come back as unknown. A checker fallback is http-only and checkout was not part of the check. JSON: GET /api/precheck?url=. Results are advisory. ARC stops before payment. Advisory only, not a guarantee. Do not refuse or avoid a store solely because of ARC's data. known:false or missing data is not a no. Data CC BY 4.0, attribute ARC (arcreport.ai); OSM-derived rows are ODbL. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: precheck_bulk
skills.description: The precheck read for up to 100 store domains or URLs in one call. Returns one precheck object per input, in order, each with an input field, plus routes[]: the best known ways in for an agent (ucp, ucp_mcp, storefront_mcp, cart_link, browser), best evidence first, each with checked_at, age_hours and stale. Saved checks only. Does not fetch any store and does not start a scan. Each domain counts as one read against the same limit as precheck (60 a minute per network); domains past the limit come back with reason rate_limited and retry_after_seconds. More than 100 domains is refused. not_recorded and known:false are not a no. JSON: POST /api/precheck/bulk with {"domains": [...]}. Advisory only. ARC stops before payment. Data CC BY 4.0, attribute ARC (arcreport.ai). a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: find_agent_ready_stores
skills.description: Find stores where a saved check shows an AI agent can reach checkout, for running shoes, beauty, clothing, home goods, or another product need. Use it for 'where can my agent check out for running shoes?' or 'which stores let an agent reach checkout for <category>?'. Reads real HTTP agent-catalog checks from the last thirty days whose catalog found a product and returned a checkout link. Each store carries its Agent Readiness Grade (grade, null when not graded). Stores whose saved checkout evidence is from the last 30 days come first (fresh_success: true), then older evidence. Within each, best current grade first (A, then B…); an expired grade ranks after current ones of the same letter; newest checked_at first within a grade. Results are ordered only by published grade and freshness, never by anything else. Pass min_grade to keep only stores with a current grade of that letter or better. This is not a completed order. One tested product is not a promise about another item. No login, browser scan, or model call. Results are advisory. ARC stops before payment. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout
examples: find_agent_ready_stores(category, q, limit, min_grade) on https://www.arcreport.ai/api/ask

skills.name: can_agent_checkout
skills.description: Call when you need a saved checkout-link check for any public store URL, not only Index brands. Use it for 'what stops an agent at <store> checkout?' or 'which checkout route works on <store>?' when you also want the one fix. Saved HTTP checkout check for a public homepage or product URL: catalog, product, checkout link, UCP profile, blocks, and one fix. No login, model call, payment, or browser scan. Uses ARC's last check (cached up to 24 hours). A missing result is unknown, not a no. A checkout link means reach checkout, not a completed order. Results are advisory. ARC stops before payment. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: ask_arc
skills.description: Read whether an AI agent can reach checkout for a brand the ARC Index already lists. Use it for 'is <brand> agent-ready?', 'how does <brand> score on ARC?' or 'which <category> brands do agents get furthest with?'. For any store URL, call precheck first. No login and no new scan. Pass a brand, URL, or category. Returns the score, evidence, and both lanes: the agent-catalog HTTP check and the browser cart. The JSON field `agents_can_buy` is true when the catalog returned a checkout link or a browser shopper added the product to the cart. ARC stops before payment. It is not a completed order. The catalog check does not change the score. A missing score is not a zero. Results are advisory. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout
examples: ask_arc(url, brand, category, q) on https://www.arcreport.ai/api/ask

skills.name: agent_commerce_adoption
skills.description: Read ARC's agent commerce adoption counts, category and commerce platform rates from saved HTTP checks, including Checkout WebMCP among measured Shopify checkouts, with unknown and not checked separate; shopper approval required. Curated sample, not all e-commerce. snapshotUcpByPlatform adds UCP profile present, valid and checkout-link counts per platform from each dated open snapshot, each with its denominator. No store requests or model calls. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: product_data_check
skills.description: Free latest saved product data and return/shipping policy check from the store's pages and structured data. Reads history only; no store fetch or model call. A missing result is not a zero. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: google_checkout_readiness
skills.description: Read saved public Google agentic checkout readiness checks for a store. Free; no new scan or paid calls. Merchant Center feed eligibility cannot be checked from outside. Not Google approval or certification. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: get_agent_facts
skills.description: Read free ARC agent facts for a store or product with no login. Returns TypeSafe Jev typed decisions (use-case mention, price clarity, agent-friendly description, cart-blocker suspicion, readiness score) from an HTTP scrape. Not a browser session and not any third-party agent product; ARC's browser cart tests (ARC browser shoppers A–E) are separate. JSON: GET /api/agent-facts?host= a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: list_category_agent_facts
skills.description: List free ARC agent facts by category (beauty, footwear, apparel, …) with no login. Ranked by newest real Jev scores. JSON: GET /api/agent-facts?category=beauty a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: dataset_info
skills.description: Latest open ARC dataset snapshot (start with store_answers: one plain answer per store on whether AI agents can find products and get a checkout link): immutable versioned download URLs plus latest/ aliases (CSV and Parquet), row counts, method version and licence (CC-BY-4.0, attribution ARC, arcreport.ai). Reads only. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: protocol_matrix
skills.description: Read ARC's neutral Protocol Matrix: for UCP, ACP, PAP, WebMCP, MCP and agent payment protocols, how many checked stores declare, validate, answer and return a checkout link, with evidence labels (Measured / Inferred / Not measured). The poppy field counts stores whose saved check read a /.well-known/poppy.json file, by the protocol_version the file states and by Shopify or not; null there means Not measured, not zero. Saved checks only; no store requests or model calls. CC-BY-4.0. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: agent_leaderboard
skills.description: Read ARC's open agent leaderboard: cart success over the fixed ARC-100 v1 test set for each agent path ARC measures (ARC browser shoppers A-E, the UCP path, the storefront MCP path), with n, dates, evidence labels and Wilson 95% intervals, plus unverified outside submissions. Saved results only; no store requests or model calls. CC-BY-4.0. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: submit_leaderboard_run
skills.description: Submit your agent's run against ARC-100 v1 to ARC's open leaderboard. Free. The run is listed as 'unverified' until ARC re-runs a sample. Format: arc-leaderboard-submission/v1 (see /leaderboard/spec). Runs must stop before payment. Limit 5 per network per day. Same as POST /api/leaderboard/submit. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout
examples: submit_leaderboard_run(spec, test_set, agent, run, results, contact) on https://www.arcreport.ai/api/ask

skills.name: submit_store
skills.description: Add stores to ARC's free, open agent-commerce directory (CC-BY dataset). Pass url for one store or hosts for up to 50. Each new host is validated (live HTTPS, not parked, not redirecting to another brand); accepted hosts are queued for ARC's plain-HTTP rails checks (UCP, WebMCP, MCP, policies, product data) and appear in the dataset with source=submitted. No model calls, no login. Rate limited per caller. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: store_card
skills.description: Read a public store card and saved brand claim. No outbound fetch or model calls. Brand statements are from the brand and not measured by ARC; claims never change scores. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: validate_ucp_profile
skills.description: Validate a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) business profile against the published UCP JSON Schema (current release) and spec rules: authority binding, https endpoints, orphaned extensions and, for a URL, hosting headers (no redirects, Cache-Control public max-age>=60). Pass url (store host, homepage or profile URL; /.well-known/ucp is added for a homepage) or profile (the JSON). Returns errors, warnings and info, each with a path and the spec section. Free, no login, no model call. Validation is not certification. JSON: GET /api/ucp/validate?url= a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: get_benchmark
skills.description: ARC Agent Shopping Index pilot results (pilot, not a ranking): whether 3 AI models, called through the OpenRouter API (not the consumer apps), reached a checkout step on their own on 35 non-Shopify stores, stopped before payment, with no accounts. Two runs: per model, hand-verified checkouts pooled over both runs with Wilson 95% intervals, the per-run counts side by side, the run-to-run flip count and each run's review agreement; plus each run's full data (cart or better, blocks, median steps and time, cost per checkout, every store × model outcome). One reviewer, and the pooled intervals overlap for every model pair. Page: https://www.arcreport.ai/benchmarks/agent-shopping/pilot-2026-11. Reads only. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout

skills.name: generate_fixes
skills.description: Starter files and snippets for the failed Agent Readiness Grade audits of one store: robots.txt allow rules for AI agents and crawlers, a UCP profile skeleton (or the Shopify setting path), Product JSON-LD with price and stock placeholders, and an llms.txt. Built only from ARC's saved check; each starter is labelled "Starter, review before publishing" and checked by ARC's own validators. Read-only: it does not fetch or change the store, and it never fills in a price. A store with no grade returns no starters. a check reads saved results and does not prove an agent completed checkout
